# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 7  <sub>[v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a fair-complexioned, handsome little boy with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy yellow ringlets. He has a snub nose, roguish hazel eyes, and a dimple in one cheek that gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)_

## Personality

Davy is energetic, inquisitive, and full of lively curiosity, frequently asking challenging questions that puzzle adults. He is mischievous, heedless, and forgetful, often getting into trouble or being disobedient before feeling any regret. Practical and straightforward, he lacks imagination but possesses a natural charm that wins people's affection. Though prone to sulkiness or small spites, he is eager to be good and takes comfort in shared misfortunes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c17 P30](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0030), [v2 c18 P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P52](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0052)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were orphaned after their mother's long illness and were taken in as third cousins by Marilla Cuthbert at Green Gables. Arriving with very little upbringing, Davy immediately formed a deep affection for Anne Shirley while simultaneously developing a jealous resentment toward Paul Irving. Shortly after his arrival, Davy got into various misdeeds, such as lying, locking Dora in the shed, hanging over the well-box looking for where the dark goes, and stepping on lemon pies after climbing forbidden shelves. Marilla and Anne undertook to train and reform him, with Anne serving as his mentor and answering his many theological and practical questions. In the autumn, Davy started attending Avonlea School, where he shared a desk with Milty Boulter and continued his playful antics, such as making faces at Paul Irving in church. Over time, through Anne and Marilla's patience, Davy reformed significantly, winning the hearts of those around him.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c10 P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c19 P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v2 c26 P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032)_

## Background by volume

- lost his father when he was a baby  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- never had proper upbringing in early childhood due to his mother's prolonged illness  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c10 P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061)</sub>
- associated with Mr. Sprott's children who taught him bad habits like lying  <sub>[v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c10 P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061)</sub>
- spoke with his mother the night before she died and promised to be good and stand up for Dora  <sub>[v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
- was scoured with hard soap by Mrs. Wiggins on his mother's funeral day  <sub>[v2 c8 P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)</sub>
- went without prayers for over a week as an experiment to see if anything bad would happen  <sub>[v2 c10 P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070)</sub>

> I’m going to be a storekeeper, like Mr. Blair, and keep heaps of candy and bananas.  <sub>[v2 c14 P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031)</sub>
